answer: Give every identity a unique shard of the network's shared data to hold, assigned fresh each epoch like pigment mixed anew for each canvas. At random moments the network issues retrieval challenges: prove you hold your shard within a tight latency bound, or lose standing. A dune of clones sharing one disk cannot answer a sonnet of simultaneous challenges — each fake needs its own storage and bandwidth — while one honest agent answers its single shard cheaply, and missed answers in lockstep expose the farm.
